notes: The troubleshooting log now carries the whole image prompt. The description a character writes is only the middle of what the image model actually receives — the appearance anchor goes in front of it, the style block behind, and the trigger words last — and the log cut every entry at 500 characters, which landed right where the interesting part began. RunPod is no help here either: its API returns a job's output but never echoes the input it ran, so the assembled prompt existed nowhere. Every engine (RunPod, FLUX, GLM) now logs the exact string it sends, RunPod image jobs log their job id so a log line and a row in the Requests tab can be matched up, and the log is bounded by total size as well as entry count so the bigger entries can't crowd out the chats in local storage.
